Definition: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tear away, seize, plunder, tear off, pull off, rob, take away by force; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tear away, rob; 1a2) to seize, plunder (with acc cognate); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be robbed; 1b2) to be taken away
